title: Warning messages and problem appearance reports
summary: This topic groups brief reports of warning messages appearing, problem onset notes, and one account-related eSIM activation issue, with limited detail and mixed subject matter across the fragments.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention an eSIM activation issue tied to added AT&T service requirements and a complaint that the customer did not know the mileage when the problem first appeared.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe warnings about overheating, drivetrain alerts, and phone push notifications without enough outcome detail to judge sentiment consistently.

limitations: The sample is very small and several fragments are too brief to determine sentiment confidently.
This cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including eSIM account/service activation and vehicle warning messages, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Some fragments provide only event descriptions or context without repair results, severity, or customer evaluation.
